_validation_summary: CRITICAL: Only 1 of 8 KPIs could be verified in source material (Dupixent/Top Drug). All other KPIs are hallucinated.

HALLUCINATED KPIs REMOVED: Pipeline (12 molecules), R&D % (18.5%), Op Margin (28.7%), FCF (5.8B), Vaccines Revenue (12.3B), FDA Approvals (2), Capex Production (1.2B). Values completely fabricated, not found in provided 20-F/6-K extracts.

Source material is severely incomplete: Only accounting policy notes (Section A, B, D notes), business segment restructuring descriptions (Opella deconsolidation), and a 6-K bond pricing announcement provided. No MD&A financial tables, segment revenue data, cash flow statements, or KPI disclosures found.
All hallucinated KPIs have been set to null values with detailed validation notes explaining why each value could not be verified.
Recommendation: Full 20-F/6-K filing and investor relations materials must be consulted before publication. Current dataset is unsuitable for use.
